description: Fork of exp428. Narrow residual stream D: 384 -> P=128 (prototype mixing interpretation: unembedder Linear(128, V) acts as 128 trainable prototypes of vocab size; residual_luts predict their weights). Reinvest the matrix savings into residual_lut tph: 128 -> 512. Total params ~85.4M (vs exp428's 89.4M, -4M). ln_final kept on the narrow P=128 stream before the prototype matmul. Otherwise identical to exp428: bs=16, 8K steps, all other LUT modules unchanged.
